KSI-CMT-RVP.purpose: Whether the change procedure works, not only whether it is followed (DECISIONS.md, 2026-09-14)

gate_runs.what: Runs and failures per pipeline gate (build-and-push, policy, drift, collect), from GitHub

gates_never_failed.what: Gates that ran in the period and failed nothing -- either protecting against nothing or passing everything

reverts.what: Commits on main that revert an earlier one -- changes that passed every gate and still had to be undone

emergency_modifications.what: In-place changes under the emergency category of registers/change-exceptions.yaml

policy_exceptions_live.what: Unexpired entries in policy/exceptions.yaml -- findings let through, each with a reason

finding_to_fix_days.what: For checks that went from failing to passing, the days it took

KSI-SCR-MIT.purpose: Supply chain risk that is not a vulnerability, and its mitigation

risks_past_review.what: Risks whose review date has passed

third_parties_unmonitored.what: Third parties whose upstream monitoring is unavailable (registers/third-parties.yaml)

dependency_audit_failures.what: Builds whose dependency audit failed, from GitHub

KSI-RPL-RRO.purpose: Recovery objectives declared, and measured against

objectives_declared.what: Resource classes with a recovery time objective (registers/resources.yaml)

objectives_measured.what: Recovery tests recorded in the period (registers/recovery-tests.yaml)

objectives_missed.what: Recorded tests whose measured recovery time exceeded the objective

KSI-RPL-ARP.purpose: Whether the recovery paths are exercised

recovery_paths_exercised.what: Distinct paths a recorded recovery test exercised in the period

backups_restorable_days.what: Days the backup restorability check passed, of the days it was judged

KSI-INR-RIR.purpose: What the detection path raised, and what the response machinery did

alerts_published.what: Messages published to the detection topic (CloudWatch)

guardduty_findings.what: GuardDuty findings updated in the period, by severity

backstop_actions.what: Times the elevation backstop removed an assignment (log store, elevations/)

not_collected.dispositions: The runbook records each alert's disposition in DECISIONS.md, as prose. Nothing counts them, so an undispositioned alert is not visible as a number

KSI-PIY-RVD.purpose: The vulnerability disclosure program's function, since its effectiveness cannot be shown here

days_served.what: Days in the period the environment serving security.txt was standing, from the run history -- it is published only while the load balancer stands

not_collected.reports_received: No intake is collected, and the published contact has no mail exchanger (PROJECT-CONTEXT open items). The count is not zero; it is unknown

KSI-PIY-RSD.purpose: The Secure by Design posture's state, from the lifecycle register and the gates

principles.what: Secure by Design principles by status

policy_gate_failures.what: Pushes to main whose policy evaluation failed, of those evaluated

checks_passing.what: The share of judged checks passing on the latest day of the period
